Each review applies the same [protocol](protocol.qmd) to one published paper: design,
measurement, model adequacy, internal consistency of the reported numbers, reporting-guideline
compliance, and whether the conclusions follow. Every numerical check is reproducible from the
code in the [repository](https://github.com/albertoalamia/articles_reviews). Authors are
contacted before a review is posted and their replies are added.

Methods and numbers are criticised, never people.

::: {#reviews}
